note: On the east shore of the 2,714-acre Chequamegon Waters Flowage, a shallow, stumpy flowage used for fishing and paddling. Electric is at sites 31-49 in the Bass loop. Sites numbered with a P are premium, with lake access or a paved pad. Beaver, Bass and Hardwoods loops have flush toilets and showers; the Rustic loop (61-78) has vault toilets only, and ATVs and UTVs may ride from those sites to the Perkinstown Motorized Trail (prohibited in the other loops). Two sand beaches, a fish-cleaning station and a very shallow boat landing. --Claude
summary: Federal (Medford-Park Falls RD) campground, 78 sites (73 in the rec.gov catalog), 41 reservable on recreation.gov, the rest first-come. 17 electric sites at 50 A, no water/sewer hookups, showers and flush toilets in three loops, dump. $15-28, open May 20 - Sept 30 with the Rustic loop open in winter on an unplowed road. Lakefront is borderline: rec.gov tags ten single sites Lakefront, but every pad sits 30-50 m (or more) from shore under continuous hardwood canopy, so lakeview is proposed. OHV side: the Rustic loop allows ATVs to ride to the Perkinstown Motorized Trail, which starts at the campground.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, not --AWH; evidence 'Beaver Loop 16-19 front Chequamegon Waters Flowage, lakeside fee'): PROPOSE lakefront -> lakeview, reviewer's call. For: rec.gov 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on single sites P06, P08, P11, P13, P15, P16 (Beaver loop, first-come by the night, $18, unplaced in the catalog; the loop's west road at about 45.2215,-90.7082 is about 55 m from the shore, so its lake-side pads sit roughly 30-45 m back) and P37 (45.21937,-90.70499), P39 (45.21907,-90.70473), P42 (45.21865,-90.70390), P43 (45.21867,-90.70361) (Bass loop, reservable by the night, $28 electric). The rec.gov photos of P06 and P16 (spring, leaf-off) show the lake through open hardwoods with no underbrush. Against: on Esri imagery the canopy is unbroken from every loop to the waterline. P42/P43 plot about 40-50 m from shore, while P37/P39 plot about 90-100 m from the shore of a marshy inlet. No pad has open ground to the water seen from above. The stored evidence's 'Beaver Loop 16-19' is partly wrong: rec.gov tags P16 but not 17-19, which are standard sites S17-S19.

OHV (flag only, a general campground with an OHV side): 'The Rustic Loop (Sites 61-78) allows ATV and UTV operation between the campsite and the Perkinstown ATV Trail. ATV and UTV operations are prohibited in the Beaver, Bass, and Hardwood Loops.' The Perkinstown Motorized Trail trailhead (day-use fee) is in the campground. The other three loops (60 sites, including all electric) are general camping.
